meta.note: chandrabala = house counted from the natal Moon sign to the transit Moon sign, 1..12. For the garbhadhana profile this component is INFORMATIONAL (displayed, zero weight) because §5.2 of the master plan allots the 15 chart-dependent points to Tara Bala. Other categories may weight it.

translations.en: Moon transits the natal Moon sign (1st) — mixed.

rules.interpretation: Personally significant but not strengthening for a new undertaking.

translations.en: Moon in the 2nd from natal Moon — favourable, gives sustenance.
Moon in the 3rd from natal Moon — strongly favourable.

rules.interpretation: One of the classical upachaya positions for Chandra Bala.

translations.en: Moon in the 4th from natal Moon — unfavourable.

rules.interpretation: The 4th, 8th and 12th from the natal Moon are the rejected positions.

translations.en: Moon in the 5th from natal Moon — acceptable; the 5th signifies progeny.
translations.hi: चन्द्र पंचम में — ग्राह्य; पंचम सन्तान-स्थान।

rules.interpretation: Not in the classical 'good' list, but the 5th is the progeny house, which is directly relevant here.

translations.en: Moon in the 6th from natal Moon — favourable (upachaya).
Moon in the 7th from natal Moon — strongly favourable; the house of the spouse.
translations.hi: चन्द्र सप्तम में — अत्यन्त अनुकूल; दाम्पत्य स्थान।

rules.interpretation: Classically good, and the 7th signifies conjugal union.

translations.en: Moon in the 8th from natal Moon — the weakest position; avoid.
translations.hi: चन्द्र अष्टम में — सर्वाधिक दुर्बल; वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Ashtama Chandra is the strongest Chandra Bala prohibition.

translations.en: Moon in the 9th from natal Moon — middling.

rules.interpretation: Neither listed as favourable nor rejected.

translations.en: Moon in the 10th from natal Moon — favourable (upachaya).
Moon in the 11th from natal Moon — the best position.

rules.interpretation: The labha sthana; gain and fulfilment of desire.

translations.en: Moon in the 12th from natal Moon — unfavourable, loss-giving.

rules.interpretation: One of the three rejected positions (4, 8, 12).
